title: Personal Checking: how wire, official check, stop payment, card replacement and research fees are assessed
content:
## Scope

This policy governs the service fees on a Personal Checking account. Every amount and the number of free stop payment orders are each tier's own published figures; this policy states which event triggers which fee.

## Formal clauses

1. **Tier used.** Service fees are assessed at the tier in force on the day of the service.
2. **Wires.** An outgoing domestic wire incurs the domestic wire fee and an outgoing international wire incurs the international wire fee, each tied to the wire debit. An incoming wire credit incurs the incoming wire fee.
3. **Official checks.** An official (cashier's) check purchase incurs the official check fee.
4. **Stop payments.** A stop payment order or renewal incurs the stop payment fee, tied to the order, except that the tier's free allowance of orders and renewals placed in a statement cycle, counted in order-date order, are free.
5. **Replacement debit card.** A replacement card incurs the standard replacement fee when the reason is lost or damaged, and no standard fee when the reason is stolen, compromised or expired. Rush delivery additionally incurs the rush fee whatever the reason.
6. **Account research.** Account research requested by the customer incurs the hourly research fee per started hour, with a one-hour minimum. Research needed to investigate a bank error or a dispute is never charged.
7. **Zero fee.** A tier fee of 0.00 records no fee.
8. **Daily limit.** Service fees are not subject to the daily overdraft-item limit.

## Card replacement by reason

| Reason | Standard delivery | Rush delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Lost | Standard fee | Standard fee and rush fee |
| Damaged | Standard fee | Standard fee and rush fee |
| Stolen | No standard fee | Rush fee only |
| Compromised | No standard fee | Rush fee only |
| Expired | No standard fee | Rush fee only |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- **Started hours.** Customer-requested research that takes 1 hour 20 minutes covers two started hours, so the hourly fee applies twice. Research lasting 15 minutes is charged at the one-hour minimum.
- **Research for a bank error.** Research needed to investigate a fee the bank charged in error is not charged at all.
- **Free stop payments counted in order-date order.** On a hypothetical tier with one free order per cycle, an owner places a stop payment on the 3rd of the cycle, renews another on the 9th and places a third on the 20th. The order of the 3rd is free; the renewal of the 9th and the order of the 20th each carry the stop payment fee.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a stolen card replaced by rush delivery is free". **Correct basis:** the rush fee applies whatever the reason; only the standard fee is excused for a stolen card.
- **Wrong reading:** "a busy day of wires uses up the day's overdraft fee limit". **Correct basis:** service fees are not subject to the daily overdraft-item limit.
